package provides automatic TypeScript type generation for translation keys. It analyzes your JSON translation files and generates strict types, enabling full type-safety and autocomplete support for translation keys.
is an optional dev dependency that enhances your development experience by:
- Scans JSON translation files and generates TypeScript types
- Prevents typos and invalid translation keys at compile time
- Full IDE autocomplete for translation keys
- Automatically regenerates types when translation files change
- Types are compile-time only, no impact on bundle size

Runtime type guards are not recommended
- Generating a JavaScript array of all keys would bloat your bundle
- i18n-micro is designed to be lightweight and fast
